question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Concede
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Concede"** means to admit or accept that something is true or valid after first denying or resisting it. (स्वीकार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **After a long debate, he finally conceded that he was wrong.
 
 
 
• **"Deny"** means to state that something is not true, or to refuse to accept or admit something. (अस्वीकार करना)
 
 
• **Example: **She denied any involvement in the robbery.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Concede'** is **'Deny'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Surrender** (आत्मसमर्पण करना): To give up or hand over (a person, right, or possession), typically on compulsion or demand.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers had to surrender after a long battle.
 
 
 
• **Battle** (लड़ाई): A sustained fight between large organized armed forces.
 
 
• **Example:** The two armies were locked in a fierce battle.
 
 
 
• **Avow** (स्वीकार करना): To assert or confess openly.
 
 
• **Example:** He avowed his commitment to the cause.
